text:
elaine (partnerships): quick kickoff — we need to activate AWS / GCP / Azure marketplace listings this sprint. goal: staging listings + publisher sandbox by next tue. main gaps: EULA + legal signoff, AMI/container artifacts, sku <-> entitlement mapping, pricing bundles, sample trial config. who can own which pieces?
praveen (cloud): i can own the AMI/container builds for aws + gcp. will need publisher account access and region list. question: do we target all regions or us/eu only for v1?
tess (product): i'll own packaging (docs, landing copy, screenshots) + marketing assets. will draft a minimal listing template by EOD tmrw. also will collate screenshots — need env creds.
matt (legal): for eula + commercial terms i need the SKU mapping and pricing tiers. also flag: we need to confirm SOC2/attestation copy for marketplace compliance. aim to have draft eula by wed.
chris (eng): will prepare terraform publisher bootstrap + deployment scripts. can we standardize the SKU manifest format? propose this small CSV schema:

```
sku_id,display_name,entitlement_code,trial_days,price_tier
redwood-std,Redwood Standard,ENT-STD,14,tier-1
redwood-pro,Redwood Pro,ENT-PRO,30,tier-2
```

chris (eng): also need container registry creds and a stable model artifact tag to reference in the listing.
sarah (solutions): i'll handle trial entitlements and sample customer entitlements mapping. i'll also set up a prompt/cost estimate snippet for the marketplace listing (so prospects see token pricing).
deploy-bot: staging publisher sandbox created: publisher-sandbox-3123, aws/gcp regions: us-east-1, europe-west1, azure-westus2.
praveen (cloud): thanks bot. i'll limit v1 to us + eu to keep AMI footprint small. happy to expand after initial smoke tests.
tess (product): marketing needs hero screenshot + 60s demo video. can the eng team produce a short demo build for the listing? even a recorder of the UI is fine.
chris (eng): yes, i can spin up a demo instance and record a 45s flow. point me to the happy-path prompts.
elaine (partnerships): blocker check: 
- legal: eula by wed (matt)
- packaging: listing assets + template by tmrw (tess)
- infra: publisher access + AMIs by fri (praveen/chris)
- sku manifest + pricing: chris + matt to align by thu
- sandbox: provisioned (deploy-bot)

can folks ack and add any missing dependencies? i'll schedule a 30m sync fri morning for final handoff. :thumbsup:
praveen (cloud): ack, will request publisher account invite today.
matt (legal): ack, will review the csv mapping and loop in compliance for SOC docs.
tess (product): ack — will attach assets in this thread when ready.
chris (eng): ack — i'll post a short terraform snippet for publisher bootstrap in this thread shortly.
sarah (solutions): ack — will prepare entitlement test cases and a short runbook for support after launch.
elaine (partnerships): perfect — if no other blockers i'll post the calendar invite for fri 09:30 PT. thanks all! :party_parrot:
